Version 0.83.0

### ✨ New

- Improved Kimi Code, with support for background tasks, sub agents, and token usage tracking.
- A brand new desktop onboarding flow: first launch now includes an intro sequence and product tour, lets you pick a theme and language, detects the agents already installed on your machine, and walks you through your first session.
- Agents can now configure the workspace's MCP servers for you.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed session worktree restore failing when offline or when the remote repository was unreachable.
- Fixed the CLI reporting a version that did not match the released one.
- Fixed dsh compatibility issues.
- Improved how the dsh agent presents its thinking.
